# Bounty Math Solver - LLM Index

> Computational verification toolkit and mathematical analysis for integer sequence conjectures, mixed polygonal sums, and arithmetic Ramsey theory problems by Raj123-0.

## Overview
This repository provides independent computational verifiers, algebraic reductions, formal LaTeX proofs, Lean 4 formalization, and circle method analytical reports for open conjectures in number theory and combinatorics.

## Key Files & Modules
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/README.md): Project overview, scope disclaimer, and usage guide.
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/llms-full.txt): Complete consolidated repository content in a single file for full context ingestion.
- [lean/A306477_MinorArc.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/lean/A306477_MinorArc.lean): Lean 4 formalization of Weyl sums and minor arc estimates.
- [docs/a306477_circle_method_analysis.tex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/docs/a306477_circle_method_analysis.tex): LaTeX paper on circle method asymptotics and minor arc bounds.
- [docs/a306477_obstruction_report.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/docs/a306477_obstruction_report.md): Quantitative exponent analysis of the minor arc defect.
- [docs/mathematical_proofs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/docs/mathematical_proofs.md): Full mathematical proofs and structural reductions.
- [proofs/rado_claim.tex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/proofs/rado_claim.tex): LaTeX document containing formal proofs for off-diagonal Rado parity theorems.
- [src/a306477_checker.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/src/a306477_checker.py): Exact integer binomial coefficient solver for OEIS A306477.
- [src/ternary_polygonal_solver.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/src/ternary_polygonal_solver.py): Mixed polygonal number verifier for OEIS A287616.
- [src/quadratic_form_local_global.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/src/quadratic_form_local_global.py): Local p-adic congruence explorer.
- [src/rado_checker.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/src/rado_checker.py): SAT-based verification engine for Rado numbers.
- [tests/test_binomial.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/tests/test_binomial.py): Unit test suite for A306477 checker.
- [tests/test_all_verifications.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Raj123-0/bounty-math-solver/master/tests/test_all_verifications.py): Full test suite covering all modules.
